data.body:
AC7 [operator-attested] — live external-provider matrix EVIDENCE.

Instrument: pytest -m 'external and llm_live' tests/external/test_review_discovery_live.py (auto-selected by the provider matrix), on the MERGED cutover (origin/main commit 4d6c1cc835e0).
Environment: external-provider-matrix (GitHub Actions, .github/workflows/external-integration.yml); principal: configured CI workload identity (per-arm credential preflight; bedrock via OIDC-scoped role).
Run URL: https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/32579533715 (dispatched 2026-08-22 ~14:43 UTC).

The canary (test_live_plan_review_discovery_reaches_the_provider_and_stays_narrow) is provider-agnostic (gates only on live_llm_ready, no provider pin), so it EXECUTED on all three arms and asserted: >=1 real discovery call reached the configured provider (coverage.llm_ran=True, llm_unavailable!=True), a REAL narrow verdict (PASS/BLOCK, schema-conformant to plan_review_verdict), and the reducer-ignored internal journal retained (sidecar_emitted=True) — no secret/prompt/trace printed.

Per-arm result (provider | job | duration | arm calls, all outcome=ok | canary):
- anthropic (claude-haiku-4-5 / opus-4-8 / sonnet-4-6) | job 97046716512 | 13m37s | 85 calls | PASS (arm 16 passed, 3 bedrock-pinned skipped, 0 failed).
- openai (gpt-5.4 / -mini / -nano) | job 97046716557 | 4m05s | 94 calls | PASS (arm 16 passed, 0 failed).
- bedrock (us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5 / opus-4-8 / sonnet-4-6, OIDC role) | job 97046716431 | 14m04s | 89 calls | canary PASS (llm-live-canary collected=19 executed=19 skipped=0; 18 passed). The bedrock ARM is RED, but on an UNRELATED pre-existing test: tests/external/test_completion_banking_behavior_0707.py::test_dense_completion_banks_and_terminates_in_two_of_three_trials (AssertionError successes=0/3, each trial banked=5 verdict=PASS) — provider-specific to bedrock (green on anthropic/openai), not S7's canary and not caused by this change. Filed as a follow-up bug.

Final result: the real default plan-review discovery path drove live provider calls on all 3 arms and the canary passed on all 3; the cross-gate cutover is proven at the real provider boundary. Call count: >=1 discovery call/arm from the canary; arm totals 85/94/89, all ok.
